title: Multimodal Data Normalizer
outcome: Turn text, images, audio, video, and sensor streams into linked structured objects
breakthrough: Unstructured media becomes directly usable by applications
lane: Schema, data shape, database, and information transformation

phases.name: Phase 1 - Build the Multimodal Data Normalizer Core

subphases.name: 1.1 Multimodal Data Normalizer Domain Model and State Plane
work: Define typed entities, capabilities, jobs, events, state transitions, and outputs required to turn text, images, audio, video, and sensor streams into linked structured objects, with explicit versions and validation at every boundary.

Implement an owned persistent state layer optimized for schemas, migrations, semantic data, event shapes, temporal state, data translation, and storage optimization; include snapshots or event history when state changes over time.
Expose create, query, update, subscribe, and delete operations through local APIs plus an SDK that never requires private cross-runtime imports.

subphases.name: 1.2 Multimodal Data Normalizer Execution Runtime
work: Build resumable workers and state machines that perform the core operation: turn text, images, audio, video, and sensor streams into linked structured objects.
Add cancellation, idempotency, bounded retries, timeouts, quotas, sandbox limits, and deterministic recovery from partial failure.
Create a local simulator that can replay success, malformed inputs, disconnection, overload, provider loss, and restart recovery.

phases.name: Phase 2 - Make Multimodal Data Normalizer Adaptive and Usable

subphases.name: 2.1 Multimodal Data Normalizer Decision and Learning Engine
work: Implement scoring, planning, prediction, search, or optimization using schema inference, semantic mapping, anomaly detection, temporal reasoning, and workload-aware tuning.
Create feedback signals from task outcomes and user corrections; update tunable behavior without silently changing hard safety limits.
Return confidence, alternatives, bottlenecks, and a concise machine-readable explanation for every important automated choice.

subphases.name: 2.2 Multimodal Data Normalizer Interaction Surface
work: Build the primary experience in the schema studio, migration simulator, object graph explorer, and live data-shape monitor, including live state, controls, errors, and recovery actions.
Add a CLI and typed client library so humans, agents, games, and third-party applications can operate the capability directly.
Stream progress and intermediate artifacts in real time so long operations remain inspectable, interruptible, and steerable.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Scale Multimodal Data Normalizer into a Breakthrough Product

subphases.name: 3.1 Multimodal Data Normalizer Offline, Edge, and Cloud Mesh
work: Implement local-only, hybrid, and cloud execution with explicit capability discovery and graceful behavior when optional peers disappear.
Add conflict-safe synchronization, workload placement, caching, backpressure, and failover across devices or nodes where the feature benefits from distribution.
Benchmark latency, throughput, memory, energy, network transfer, and cost; make the scheduler choose the best execution mode from measured constraints.

subphases.name: 3.2 Multimodal Data Normalizer Signature Breakthrough
work: Implement the differentiating behavior: Unstructured media becomes directly usable by applications. Ship it as an opt-in executable mode, not a mockup.
Run adversarial, load, privacy, misuse, degraded-network, and recovery tests against the novel behavior; block unsafe automatic actions.
Package the feature as an independently installable capability with a live demo, sample integration, metrics endpoint, and rollback-safe release artifact.
